question: Should Oracle support authenticated state-changing Codex Cloud finding actions, or should this contribution be limited to read-only list and detail inspection?
rationale: Creating PRs, submitting finding chats, and closing or adjusting findings expands Oracle from inspection into remote state mutation, and existing repository history does not establish that product boundary.

options.title: Land read-only first
options.body: Split out repository-neutral list and detail inspection, then reconsider mutating actions in a focused, fully proven follow-up.

options.title: Ship repaired actions
options.body: Accept the complete action surface after fixing selector scoping, postconditions, repository semantics, and runtime proof.

options.title: Decline the workflow
options.body: Keep Codex Cloud findings outside Oracle if authenticated DOM mutation is too brittle to support.

recommendation.title: Land read-only first
recommendation.body: Split out repository-neutral list and detail inspection, then reconsider mutating actions in a focused, fully proven follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and most recently owns the adjacent Oracle CLI and browser automation architecture.
